item.title: Corollaries Nobody Wrote Down
item.description: Four long-standing questions in mathematical physics that follow in one line from theorems in OpenAI's September 2026 manuscript collection, yet are stated nowhere: the 2D random ferromagnet, the spin-1 Heisenberg chain, and minimal spanning forests.
